operations.resolveAndStageConflictingFil.en: Resolve and Stage conflicting files before Continue.
operations.resolveAndStageConflictingFil.zh-CN: 请先解决冲突并暂存文件，再继续。

operations.noUnmergedFilesInGitInspectTh.en: No unmerged files in Git. Inspect the staged result before Continue; content correctness has not been verified.
operations.noUnmergedFilesInGitInspectTh.zh-CN: Git 中已无未标记的冲突文件。继续前请检查暂存结果；内容正确性尚未验证。

operations.reviewTheActiveOperationBefor.en: Review the active operation before continuing.
operations.reviewTheActiveOperationBefor.zh-CN: 请检查当前操作后继续。

operations.skipTheCurrentCommitInThisOpe.en: Discard the current commit’s application and conflict-resolution edits, then continue the remaining commits.
operations.skipTheCurrentCommitInThisOpe.zh-CN: 丢弃当前提交的应用结果及冲突处理改动，继续后续提交。

operations.quitEffect.en: End Cherry-pick and keep the current HEAD, working files and Index exactly as they are, including unresolved conflicts. Already applied commits remain; remaining commits will not be applied.
operations.quitEffect.zh-CN: 退出 Cherry-pick，保留当前 HEAD、工作区和暂存区的原样状态，包括未解决的冲突。已应用的提交保留，剩余提交不再应用。

operations.quitNext.en: You can then edit the files, mark and stage resolved conflicts, and create a normal commit. Continue, Skip and Abort for this Cherry-pick will no longer be available.
operations.quitNext.zh-CN: 退出后可手动编辑文件、标记并暂存处理结果，再普通提交。本次 Cherry-pick 将无法再继续、跳过或中止。

operations.skipEffect.en: This discards the current commit’s application and conflict-resolution edits. Already applied commits remain, and Git continues the remaining commits. For a single commit, the operation ends and can look the same as Abort.
operations.skipEffect.zh-CN: 将丢弃当前提交的应用结果及冲突处理改动。已应用提交保留，Git 继续后续提交；单条提交时操作直接结束，看起来可能与中止相同。

operations.cherryPickAbortEffect.en: Abort rolls back this entire Cherry-pick sequence, including commits already applied in this batch. Manual conflict-resolution edits may be lost. This does not keep the current files for you to resolve later.
operations.cherryPickAbortEffect.zh-CN: 中止会撤销本次整批 Cherry-pick，包括本批已成功应用的提交；手动处理冲突的改动可能丢失。此操作不会保留当前文件供稍后处理。

operations.cherryPickKeepAlternative.en: To exit and keep your files instead, cancel this dialog and choose Quit Cherry-pick & Keep Files… in the operation bar.
operations.cherryPickKeepAlternative.zh-CN: 如果想退出但保留文件，请取消此窗口，再点击操作条的“退出 Cherry-pick，保留文件…”。
